about_the_game:
Those bullets will kill the future of the girl — a Dark Horror TPS

The girl was chosen as the bride <sacrifice>.

In a fictional postwar era, the Imperial Capital, bubbling with reconstruction, was struck by disaster once more.

The evil “Dragon God,” dwelling within the Imperial Capital Tower—a symbol of revival—

glared down upon the exhausted city, its fangs poised to sink into its throat.

Thus, the people, driven to desperation, decided to offer a sacrifice and beg for mercy.

The powerless forced the sacrifice upon the even weaker.

The Dragon God's bride—that was the fate imposed upon an unfortunate girl each year.

About the Game

This is a horror action-adventure combining exploration, puzzle-solving, combat, and character growth.
Players take the role of the chosen Bride of the Dragon God, exploring the city and the ruins beyond in a struggle against fate.

Key Features

  • Exploration and Puzzle-Solving
    Unlock sealed doors, solve mysterious mechanisms, and collect sacred orbs to progress.
    The ruins, once a battlefield, are now haunted by abandoned artificial soldiers.

  • Intense Combat
    Face not only ordinary enemies but also massive, terrifying bosses.
    Evade deadly attacks, identify weak points, and strike at the right moment to prevail.

  • The City and Its Inhabitants
    Within the city, you can trade with NPCs to purchase recovery items, upgrade weapons, and enhance your maximum health.
    Completing side quests may grant you rare items or vital information — though not all citizens can be trusted.

  • Growth and Choices that Shape the Ending
    Strengthen your weapons and abilities to survive.
    Encounter the darkness of the city, uncover the truth of the Dragon God, and make decisions that will shape the Bride’s destiny.

Player Experience

  • Tension-filled exploration of abandoned ruins

  • The thrill of defeating gigantic enemies

  • Strategic depth through interaction and trading with NPCs

  • Multiple endings shaped by the player’s choices

Your choices will determine her fate.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat involving firearms and blades, as well as grotesque depictions including blood.

short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, Korean
